Destructibles.Name: Wooden Crate
Destructibles.Description: A weak wooden box. Towers can break it open for bonus gold.

Destructibles.Name: Oil Barrel
Destructibles.Description: Highly volatile. A single hit is enough to detonate the whole barrel.

Description: Destructible obstacle prototypes (Round 95 Direction 5). Crate drops gold on destroy; Oil Barrel explodes for 50% of enemy max HP in a 5-tile radius. Towers auto-target destructibles when no enemy is in range, so leaving destructibles in your fire lane gives you free secondary economy/utility. Set MaxHealth=0 to disable a prototype.
